description: constraints.php is the lowest PHP supported, not the newest; constraintsFiltering enforces it.
No schedule: minimumReleaseAge is the only gate, so a window would just add latency on top of it.

packageRules.description: addLabels, not labels — labels is last-match-wins.
Pinned, so every release is a PR that CI fully verifies.
Digest-pinned: a moved tag cannot slip in.

The public contract. widen fires only for a release outside the range, so the constraint syntax decides the behaviour and one rule covers both: ray/compiler is pinned to a minor and gets a PR for each new one, ray/di is a caret the consuming app also declares and is left alone until a major. No automerge — widening the contract is a decision.
Renovate reads its own constraints block as a dependency. Not an update.
